# dsh-plugin-resolver

> Agent-facing installer for DSH plugins. One tool call: search the catalog, settle same-name entries, pick a version the running DSH accepts, install from registry or GitHub source, and read the mount back.

Canonical machine contract: ./agent.json
Human reference: https://sakikoTGW.github.io/dsh-plugin-resolver/docs/
Version: 0.1.6
Host: DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0 · Node >=20
License: MIT

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-resolver
```

Market index source (add as an index source, then install from Discover):

```
https://sakikoTGW.github.io/dsh-plugin-resolver/market/index.json
```

## Tools

- `plugin_search` — read-only. Input: query. Returns catalog hits with owner, stars, npm name, install command, ambiguity flag.
- `plugin_resolve` — read-only. Input: target. Returns package, install spec, registry, source-build requirement, notes.
- `plugin_install` — writes profile, lockfile and plugin-sources. Input: target. Returns applied state, bundle/loader entry, restart decision, next step.
- `plugin_status` — read-only. Returns installed bundles, loader entries, fiberPhase.

Only `plugin_install` writes the environment.

## Version rule

- Running version: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` in `pluginManager.listBundles()`.
- A declared `engines.dsh` is authoritative.
- Without `engines.dsh`, every same-namespace `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer must accept the running version, optional peers included. Sibling libraries on other version lines are excluded.
- Selection: first compatible version. An explicit version skips resolution.

## Ambiguity

Same-name entries stay visible. Supply `owner=` or a full spec; the plugin does not choose for you.

## Restart

Compare the bundle set and runtime file hashes; the plugin manager's application result is authoritative.

## Validation

```
npm test
```

Expected: 45 passing (35 logic + 10 harness). CI: https://github.com/sakikoTGW/dsh-plugin-resolver/actions/workflows/test.yml
